description: Deploys the app's room.js runner as a Worker on the developer's own Cloudflare account (Cloudflare bills them). "set" uses the Cloudflare token connected in the panel (never ask for it in chat; if none, the error has a panel link for the developer), switches the app to serverMode "own" and deploys; saving a server/ file redeploys. "remove" deletes the Worker but leaves serverMode "own": rooms then need `npx @neblla/server` running (neblla_server_key), or neblla_update_app_rooms serverMode "cloud" (Neblla's servers). Acts at once. set: owner only. More: neblla_get_llms tools/byos
